## Objective
The model "mucosa" in the fragment quality suite (fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/)
classifies mucosal segments based on if they contain small intestinal mucosa, and
quality of the mucosa (orientation and percentage artefact).

The performance metrics for each class compared to the majority opinion of three pathologists 
are calculated in fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/scripts/validate_mucosa)

This chunk is to calculate the performance specifically for the purpose of how it is used in this paper,
namely to identify small intestinal mucosal segments of acceptable quality (adequate or marginal orientation and arteafct)
and filter out automatically detected mucosal segments that eiter do not 
contain any small intestinal mucosa, or have inadequate orientation or levels of artefact.


```{r}
library(writexl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
comparison_df <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa_validation/mucosa_ai_and_ref.json")


template <- comparison_df %>%
  mutate(tp = case_when(
    small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 1 & orientation_ref != 3 & artefact_ref != 3 &
    small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 1 & orientation_ai != 3 & artefact_ai != 3 ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE),
    fp = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 0  | orientation_ref == 3 | artefact_ref == 3) &
        small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 1 & orientation_ai != 3 & artefact_ai != 3 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    tn = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 0 | orientation_ref == 3 |  artefact_ref == 3) &
        (small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 0 | orientation_ai == 3 | artefact_ai == 3) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    fn = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 1 & orientation_ref != 3 & artefact_ref != 3) &
        (small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 0 | orientation_ai == 3 | artefact_ai == 3) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE))

summary_df_new <- template %>%
  summarise(
    tp = sum(tp),
    fp = sum(fp),
    tn = sum(tn),
    fn = sum(fn)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
      sensitivity = if_else(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA_real_),
      specificity = if_else(tn + fp > 0, tn / (tn + fp), NA_real_),
      ppv         = if_else(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA_real_),
      npv         = if_else(tn + fn > 0, tn / (tn + fn), NA_real_),
      balanced_accuracy = if_else(
  !is.na(sensitivity) & !is.na(specificity),
  (sensitivity + specificity) / 2,
  NA_real_
),
      f1          = if_else(ppv + sensitivity > 0,
                            2 * ppv * sensitivity / (ppv + sensitivity),
                            NA_real_)
    )

#write_xlsx(template, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx//output/performance_mucosa/performance_template_mucosa.xlsx")

#write_json(summary_df, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx//output/performance_mucosa/performance_mucosa.json", pretty = TRUE)

print(summary_df_new)
```
